items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: on the head was a picture of Rudolph Valentino and Pola Negro, painted on your bass drum head.

ctx.x: I think they were Ludwigs. I think, I'm not sure. Ludwigs or Slingerland.

Anyway, inside the bass drum, they used to have electric light bulbs that would go on and off and on the head was a picture of Rudolph Valentino and Pola Negro, painted on your bass drum head. So I used to get on this gig a little early and set my drums up and plug it in and look at the lights go on and off, you know, about an hour before we'd even start playing, and we would get, like I told you, five dollars a night, sometimes not that if business wasn't good, but we were young and having a ball, having fun,…
